_warning: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT. Built from the CSV by scripts/build-data.mjs; edits are lost on the next build. Edit the CSV, then run: npm run data:build

kwk_name.note: Cartridge designation as the primary compilation (kwk) spells it.

secondary_name.note: The same cartridge as the secondary compilation spells it. Recorded separately rather than assumed identical, because a naming difference is itself the reason several rows cannot be matched automatically.

unit.note: Unit both figures are expressed in, so delta is meaningful.

secondary_value.note: The secondary compilation's figure for the same cartridge.

delta.note: secondary_value minus kwk_value. Left blank rather than computed in the CSV when it is not yet established which way round the subtraction goes.

resolution.note:
How the disagreement was settled. - unresolved: nobody has checked the standard body yet. - both_valid: not actually a conflict; the two publish different methods
  (piezo vs cup) or different vintages, and both may be right.
- typo_in_name: the figures agree; the cartridges were matched by mistake.

resolution_note.note: What the resolution rests on. May contain commas; keep quoted. An unresolved row with no note is a task, not an oversight.

rows.resolution_note: Compilations disagree beyond tolerance. Resolve against SAAMI Z299.x or CIP TDCC before publishing.
